name: Pat Stryker
current_role: Founder and president, Bohemian Foundation (Fort Collins, Colorado)
profile: Granddaughter of Stryker Corp. founder Homer Stryker; her fortune comes from inherited Stryker stock. Based in Fort Collins, she founded the Bohemian Foundation in 2001 (music, community, global and civic programs), has given ~$225M to charity, redevelops downtown Fort Collins real estate and is a major Democratic donor.
interesting_fact: In 2016 she and her brother Jon Stryker gave a combined $10M to fund the first US memorial to victims of racial-terror lynchings; she is also counted among Colorado's political 'Gang of Four' donors with Tim Gill, Jared Polis and Rutt Bridges.
deep_cut_fact: She once owned a California winery, Stryker Sonoma, which she sold to focus on the foundation; the foundation built The Music District, a creative hub and workspace for Fort Collins musicians, and was named after the Paris Bohemian movement of the early 1900s.
notes: Very private; rarely gives interviews. Best route is the Bohemian Foundation (262 E. Mountain Ave, Fort Collins; main office line published on its contact page). Music/Fort Collins community angle is the natural hook.
